text:
luca: Pinging everyone-- I opened a preview for the config-churn-detector. It scans change history and runtime lookups to surface noisy keys that flip often and have low traffic. Want ops/telemetry/DevEx to confirm safeguards before we surface in Console.

meera: Good call. Two requirements from infra: (1) dont autocreate owner alerts for churn from automated deploys, (2) exempt keys flagged with `experiment` label.

ops-bot: [job] churn-detector.preview started: run=churn-2024-08-21T11:00Z id=cd-20240821-3 :gear:

tara: UX: Console should show a "High churn" badge on key detail and a small timeline of toggles. Provide a one-click "mute detector" so product teams can opt-out for a given key for 30d. Also include an explanation for why a key is noisy.

eng-telemetry: Telemetry wants events: `churn_detector.preview.start`, `churn_detector.preview.item` (sampled), and `churn_detector.preview.report`. Include churn_score, flip_count_30d, lookups_30d, owner_resolved_from. Sample 5% of low-traffic items, full for flip_count_30d>10.

devex: Recommend digest email to owners during preview and a bulk-mute modal. If owner unresolved, show banner to platform-ops with digest. Fallback owner resolution: metadata.owner -> audit.last_modifier -> platform-ops.

luca: Policy draft: 1) ignore keys <14d old; 2) exempt `experiment` and `no-detector` labels; 3) preview exports sample + full report for high-churn; 4) UI includes mute button (30d), safelist, and owner digest; 5) initial run capped at 4k keys/hour and uses incremental cursor.

meera: Ops asks for snapshotting before any automated cleanup (we won't auto-delete churned keys but future follow-ups may). Also require an audit event when mute or safelist toggles happen: `churn_detector.action` with actor id.

luca: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/churn-detector/pull/8. Holding any destructive follow-ups until ops+telemetry+devex thumbs and after a 48h preview run. Comments welcome.

eng-telemetry: Ack, we'll add schema and metrics: `churn_detector.candidates` and `churn_detector.muted_total`.

devex: Ack, will draft banner and digest copy in the PR.

luca: Thanks all  holding aggressive actions until previews finish and we have owner feedback.
